name: Tube-to-plate fillet, 50 mm tube, 240 deg arc
_comment: 50 mm OD x 40 mm tall tube standing on a plate on the 100 mm work block, tube centre at X=215 Y=0. The arm covers the far side and both flanks (-120..+120 deg). For the near side, turn the part half a turn and run again with start_angle -60 and sweep 120, or add a rotary positioner (Phase 2). A taller tube gets in the way of the forearm on the far side: the planner reports it.
